high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by Vogue Magazine. The post features two female athletes celebrating on a track and field event podium, draped with the American flag. Both athletes are wearing athletic attire, including sports bras and shorts, and are smiling broadly, exuding joy and pride. The athlete on the left is wearing a blue sports bra with "PARIS 2024" written on it and a matching blue short. She has a small American flag patch on her chest and a bib that reads "McLAUGHLIN-LEVRONE." She also wears a tiara, suggesting she may have won a title
